descriptionPlain:
DISQO is a leading provider of advertising intelligence, measuring brand and performance outcomes across every media channel to power data-driven marketing decisions. Trusted by 500+ of the world’s largest brands and 150+ agency and media partners, and recognized by Inc., Deloitte, Ad Age, Digiday, Forbes, and Cynopsis, DISQO is redefining the power of measurement in advertising.
Joining DISQO Nation means being part of a team that moves fast, thinks boldly, and is passionate about solving meaningful problems. At DISQO, our day-to-day roles are deeply integrated with AI. We actively empower every team member with cutting-edge AI tools to automate repetitive tasks and streamline workflows, allowing you to focus your energy on high-impact, strategic, and creative problem-solving. Innovation isn't just something we talk about, it's how we operate. We challenge assumptions, embrace new ideas, and continuously push ourselves to build better solutions for our customers and each other.
Our values guide how we work and win together. We believe in winning as one team, fostering a culture of collaboration, trust, and shared accountability. We pursue outsized impact by focusing on opportunities that drive meaningful results for our customers and our business. We champion the customer by putting their needs at the center of every decision and delivering solutions that create real value. And we are relentlessly all in, bringing energy, passion, and commitment to every challenge, every day.
If you're energized by high-growth environments, motivated by AI-enabled productivity, and excited by the opportunity to do impactful work alongside talented, driven teammates, you'll feel right at home at DISQO.


About the Role:
 
DISQO is looking for a Customer Success Director to own our most strategic, complex client relationships and to raise the bar for how the entire CS org operates. This is a senior individual-contributor role,— it’s for someone who wants to go deeper on craft, ownership, and impact rather than up an org chart.A CSM Director carries, hand-picked portfolio of DISQO’s highest-value and highest-complexity accounts (large committed programs, multi-stakeholder enterprise relationships, or accounts navigating significant change), operates with executive-level credibility on both sides of the table, and is looked to internally as a standard-setter: mentoring other CSMs, shaping how the team runs, and representing the voice of the customer in product and process decisions.DISQO is an AI-native company, and this role sits inside that culture rather than alongside it. We expect a CSM Director to use AI tools to work faster and smarter across the account portfolio, and to bring that same mindset to how the CS org operates and evolves. You'll be someone other CSMs look to not just for client management craft, but for how to fold AI and improve into the day-to-day of the job. 
 
 
How this role differs from the traditional Sr. CSM:

This role is scoped by complexity and influence, not headcount. Portfolio size will typically be smaller than a Senior CSM’s, but each account carries materially higher strategic weight, and the role carries an explicit mandate to improve the team’s collective practice — through mentorship, playbook development, hands-on AI fluency, and being a visible model of what “excellent” looks like against DISQO’s CSM Core Competency Model.

How this role differs from the traditional Sr. CSM:

This role is scoped by complexity and influence, not headcount. Portfolio size will typically be smaller than a Senior CSM’s, but each account carries materially higher strategic weight, and the role carries an explicit mandate to improve the team’s collective practice — through mentorship, playbook development, hands-on AI fluency, and being a visible model of what “excellent” looks like against DISQO’s CSM Core Competency Model.

lists.content:
• Strategic account leadership. Manage a portfolio of DISQO’s largest and most complex accounts — often multi-year, multi-stakeholder, and revenue-critical. Build and sustain relationships with VP/C-suite champions, not just day-to-day contacts. Own the account strategy (from- to?), not just the renewal.
  • Executive-level trust and risk management. Act as the point person when an account is strategically important, contractually complex, or at risk — bringing judgment and calm under pressure that less senior CSMs haven’t yet built. Know when to escalate, when to hold the line, and when to bring in leadership.
  • Cross-functional influence. Represent the customer’s perspective internally, in product, sales, and leadership conversations. Partner with Product on roadmap input from your accounts, with Sales on expansion strategy, and with leadership on how the book of business is trending — with enough credibility that your read on an account is trusted without a second opinion.
  • AI-forward operating model. The CSM Director demonstrates advanced use of AI in their day-to-day — building custom skills, agents, and artifacts to drive velocity,  client value and efficiency — and sets the example for what AI-native account management looks like across the team.
  • Mentorship and barsetting. Coach other CSMs on account strategy, difficult conversations, commercial acumen, and how to put AI to work in their own accounts — informally and through structured mentorship — without formal management responsibility. Model the behaviors the CSM Core Competency Model describes at its highest level.
  • Deep domain expertise. Develop and maintain expert-level fluency in DISQO’s platform, research methodologies, and each client’s industry/business context, so you can act as a genuine strategic advisor rather than a project manager — the person clients want in the room when they’re rethinking their insights strategy, not just running their next study.
  • Process and playbook contribution. Identify what’s breaking or missing in how CS operates and build the fix — a playbook, a template, an AI-powered workflow, an escalation path — so improvements outlive your own accounts.

lists.text: What you bring to the role:
lists.content:
• 10+ years in customer success, account management, or a client-facing strategic role, ideally in market research, insights, MarTech, or SaaS
  • A track record of owning complex, high-revenue accounts end-to-end, including renewal and expansion of six- and seven-figure relationships
  • Comfort operating with VP/C-suite stakeholders and navigating ambiguity, competing priorities, and organizational change on the client side
  • Strong commercial acumen — you understand how your accounts’ health connects to revenue, retention, and growth, and you can speak to it credibly with leadership
  • Demonstrated, hands-on fluency with AI. You go well beyond prompting a chatbot — you’ve built or configured custom skills, agents, or artifacts that changed how you or your team actually worked, and you bring that same instinct to how you run your accounts.
  • A demonstrated pattern of raising the level of people and process around you, even without a title that requires it
  • Deep curiosity about the client’s business, not just DISQO’s product
  • Excellent judgment about when to solve something yourself, when to loop in a specialist, and when to escalate

About the role:

You'll work at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineering and Cloud Security, keeping our platform highly available, scalable and secure by design. We treat infrastructure as software and believe security should enable engineering velocity, not block it.

You'll ship most infrastructure, automation and remediation work with AI coding agents. Your core job is to design the guardrails, reviews and tests that make that safe at scale, and to help build the internal agents that run a growing part of our reliability and security operations.

The skill we value most is judgment: knowing when an agent's output is wrong, unsafe or not ready for production, and building systems that catch it when you're not looking.

lists.content:
SRE & Dev Ops:

  • Infrastructure as code: Build and run secure, multi-account AWS infrastructure with Terraform and GitOps.

  • Kubernetes: Operate and harden Amazon EKS workloads and the container platform.

  • Service reliability: Define, track and enforce SLOs, SLIs and error budgets across our microservices, including services that depend on LLMs (fallbacks, latency and cost budgets).

  • Observability: Run and improve our observability stack on Grafana, Newrelic

  • Toil reduction: Write automation in Python or Go. Agents do much of the authoring; you own the design, testing and review.

  • Developer support: Be the go-to partner for engineering teams on infrastructure, deployments and environments. Help them debug build, pipeline and runtime issues, and turn recurring requests into self-service.

  • Infrastructure enablement: Help teams provision and change infrastructure through reviewed Terraform and GitOps workflows, and support new services from first deploy to production readiness.

  • CI/CD & release: Maintain and improve build and deployment pipelines, release processes and environment management so teams can ship quickly and safely.

    • Cloud Security:

  • AWS security posture: Own IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail and Control Tower across our accounts.

  • Zero trust & identity: Enforce least privilege and short-lived credentials for people, services and AI agents alike.

  • Network defense: Design secure network boundaries, egress filtering and WAF rules that limit blast radius.

  • Shift-left security: Embed SAST, SCA, container scanning and policy-as-code (OPA) into GitLab CI and ArgoCD without slowing teams down.

  • Vulnerability management: Scale scanning, triage and code review to match the growing volume of AI-generated code.

  • Secure by default: Partner with product teams in design reviews so new services follow secure architecture patterns.

  • Detection & response: Build detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and respond to both reliability outages and security incidents as part of the on-call rotation.

    • AI Native Platform Development:

  • Internal agents: Build and operate agents, MCP servers and skills that automate SRE and security workflows.

  • Agent identity & guardrails: Treat agents as non-human identities with scoped permissions, approval gates for high-risk actions (such as production changes and IAM edits) and full audit trails.

  • AI supply chain: Vet and pin third-party models, MCP servers and agent plugins the same way we manage open-source dependencies.

  • Data protection for AI: Control what consumer and panel data can reach external model APIs, and set usage and cost limits.

  • Agent-ready operations: Write runbooks, alerts and blameless postmortems as structured, testable steps an agent can execute, with clear stop conditions.

  • Evaluation: Test and evaluate agents before they reach production, and monitor them once they do.

    • Day to Day expectations: 

  • AI Native Platform (~50%): Building agents, paved paths and guardrails for platform engineering

  • Cloud Security (~30%): Owning AWS security posture, embedding security into CI/CD, and detection and response.

  • SRE & DevOps (~20%): Running reliable infrastructure, observability, and day-to-day developer and infrastructure support.

lists.text: What you bring to the role:
lists.content:
• Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Cloud Security Engineering roles.

  • Cloud Expertise: Strong production expertise with AWS core services, networking, multi-account governance, and AWS-native security tooling (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, KMS).

  • Infrastructure as Code: Advanced hands-on proficiency with Terraform, GitOps, and configuration management.

  • Containers & Kubernetes: In-depth knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes (EKS) administration, deployment, and container runtime security.

  • Coding & Scripting: Proven ability to write clean, modular automation code in Python or Go (not just configuring tools, but authoring custom automations, tooling, and integrations).

  • CI/CD Integration: Solid experience building, maintaining, and securing CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, ArgoCD, ArgoWorflows).

  • AI Tooling Adoption: Active, daily experience leveraging AI coding agents and development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate delivery and automate workflows.

  • Mindset: Strong collaboration, clear communication, and a philosophy that security empowers development velocity rather than acting as a blocker.

• Certifications: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CKA/CKS (Certified Kubernetes Administrator/Security Specialist), or CISSP.

  • SecOps / EDR Experience: Familiarity with endpoint security (CrowdStrike), modern SIEM/SOAR platforms, and vulnerability management workflows.

  • Compliance Frameworks: Familiarity with SOC 2 Type I/II, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA compliance requirements in cloud environments.

About the role:

You'll work at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineering and Cloud Security, keeping our platform highly available, scalable and secure by design. We treat infrastructure as software and believe security should enable engineering velocity, not block it.

You'll ship most infrastructure, automation and remediation work with AI coding agents. Your core job is to design the guardrails, reviews and tests that make that safe at scale, and to help build the internal agents that run a growing part of our reliability and security operations.

The skill we value most is judgment: knowing when an agent's output is wrong, unsafe or not ready for production, and building systems that catch it when you're not looking.

Job Overview:
As the Director of Sales, Brand Direct and Agency Partnerships, you’ll be the driving force behind DISQO’s growth with leading brands and agencies. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you’ll own the full sales cycle — from strategic prospecting and pipeline development to negotiation and close. You’ll identify and secure high-value partnerships, expanding our footprint with enterprise-level clients. Your deep knowledge of the advertising technology landscape and mastery of value-based selling through the MEDDICC framework will be key to your success. You’ll collaborate with a passionate, high-performing team while competing to exceed ambitious sales goals and deliver outsized results.

lists.content:
• Strategic Account Planning: Develop and execute comprehensive territory account plans that maximize revenue opportunities and align with company objectives.
  • Pipeline Building: Identify, qualify, and nurture high-potential leads to build a strong sales pipeline. Utilize your hunter mentality to proactively seek out new business opportunities.
  • Deal Execution: Lead the end-to-end sales process, from initial contact to contract negotiation and closing, ensuring timely and successful deal execution.
  • Quota Attainment: Consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales quotas, demonstrating a track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strategic Account Execution: Develop and maintain relationships with key decision-makers within Agency partner companies, driving strategic engagement and long-term partnership.
  • B2B Value Selling: Utilize the MEDDICC sales framework to effectively communicate the value of our solutions, aligning with customer needs and driving complex sales cycles to a successful close.
  • Advertising Technology Domain Experience: Leverage your domain knowledge to tailor solutions that address the unique challenges and opportunities within the advertising technology sector.
  • Team Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including marketing, product, and customer success, to ensure a seamless customer experience and drive cross-functional initiatives.
  • Competitive Intelligence: Utilize AI-driven market intelligence and insights to stay ahead of industry trends, anticipate competitive moves, and sharpen your positioning in real time, ensuring DISQO's story is always relevant, differentiated, and compelling to enterprise buyers.
  • Negotiation and Closing: Demonstrate exceptional negotiation skills, securing favorable terms for both the company and the customer while ensuring mutual success.
  • Hunter Mentality: Approach challenges with a fearless mindset, continuously seeking new opportunities to drive growth and achieve sales targets.
  • AI-Powered Pipeline Development: Leverage AI-enabled tools and workflows to identify high-potential prospects, personalize outreach at scale, and accelerate pipeline velocity — bringing a data-driven edge to every stage of the sales cycle.

lists.text: What you bring to the role:
lists.content:
• Experience: 7+ years of experience in complex B2B enterprise sales, preferably in the SaaS and/or Advertising Technology sectors, supporting an Agency partner driven model.
  • Proven Track Record: Demonstrated history of consistent quota overachievement and a strong ability to close complex, high-value deals.
  • Sales Methodology: Expertise in value-based selling methodology and experience with the MEDDICC sales framework.
  • Domain Expertise: In-depth knowledge of the Advertising Technology industry and the ability to translate technical solutions into business value for enterprise customers.
  • Mindset: Fearless, curious, constant learner, results-oriented, and driven by a hunter mentality.
  • Collaboration: Strong team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
  • Negotiation Skills: Exceptional negotiation and closing skills, with a strategic approach to securing business and building long-term partnerships.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred.

• Innovative Environment: Be part of a forward-thinking company that is shaping the future of media measurement.
  • Growth Opportunities: Take your career to the next level with ample opportunities for professional development and advancement at a technology company that is disrupting an extremely relevant category.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work in a supportive, team-based environment where your contributions are valued and recognized.
  • Competitive Compensation: Enjoy the competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and comprehensive benefits that you’d expect as a strategic experienced enterprise seller.

We’re looking for a strategic, data-driven, and customer-obsessed Project Manager (PM) to join our Ad Measurement team. In this role, you’ll drive the delivery of high-impact ad measurement campaigns - planning, executing, and scaling implementations that help our customers maximize their brand impact. This is not just a coordination role; you’ll be the orchestrator of cross-functional execution and the owner of the customer experience, ensuring every campaign is delivered with clarity, confidence, and excellence.

lists.content:
• Lead ad measurement project delivery from kickoff through insights prep, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
  • Own the alignment of campaign inputs - media plans, assets, sampling, and mapping - and be the final checkpoint for accuracy and readiness.
  • Champion proactive communication, surface risks early, and lead customer conversations with confidence.
  • Coordinate internal teams (Ad Ops, Analytics, Product, Sales, and Insights) using structured project plans, shared trackers, and standardized meeting cadences.
  • Ensure sampling strategies and mappings are executed with precision, driving credibility in outcomes and trust with our customers.
  • Facilitate weekly project meetings, manage timelines, and track action items to keep delivery on track and visible across teams.
  • Escalate roadblocks with clarity and help prioritize solutions with internal stakeholders.
  • Bring strategic perspective to every campaign - always thinking about what’s best for the customer and how to optimize future delivery.
  • Beyond that, the sky’s the limit.  Know that you will be fully supported to reach your full potential and maximize your impact on DISQO’s future.

lists.text: You’ll be successful in this role if you:
lists.content:
• If you're obsessed with creating seamless, thoughtful, and impactful customer experiences, you'll thrive - because at DISQO, we believe that exceptional delivery is the foundation of trusted partnerships and long-term growth.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with many moving parts.
  • Are energized by solving problems and creating structure where it doesn’t yet exist.
  • Love details and know how to turn chaos into calm through planning, communication, and clarity.
  • Are comfortable speaking with customers and internal stakeholders - and know how to make complex work feel smooth and simple.

lists.text: What you bring to the role:
lists.content:
• 4+ years of project management experience in MarTech, AdTech, or SaaS organizations
  • Solid knowledge of digital marketing and the AdTech ecosystem
  • 2+ years of direct customer-facing experience, with a demonstrated ability to listen to feedback and proactively adjust project delivery
  • A knack for breaking down complex processes and technical concepts into clear, actionable steps
  • Strong organizational, operational, analytical, and presentation skills, combined with excellent verbal and written communication
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, with strong data analysis and problem-solving abilities
  • A desire to work in a fast-paced environment where you can learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact
  • A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or sufficient experience otherwise
